lesson.menu_desc: Reading the email thread with the vendor and doing a full support call -- review of lessons 1 to 5
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 6 -- Review: Ticket Closed
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Diogo Campos Silva | Lesson 6 -- Review: Ticket Closed

listenings.text: Hi Diogo, this is Linda from SecureNet. I am calling about ticket six one nine. Your email says the problem is solved. That is great news. I am closing the ticket today. If you have a new problem, you can open a ticket on our website or by phone. Have a good weekend.

Hello Diogo, it's Ravi. I am sending you the report now. It is in the attachment. The problem is an old version of the VPN app. Now all your users have the new version, and they can work from home. Please read the report and reply to my email. Thank you for your patience.

extra_audio.text: Diogo writes an email to the vendor. He sends a screenshot in the attachment. Linda replies: our team is checking the server. The VPN is working again. Diogo writes: the problem is solved. You can close the ticket.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a picture of what you see on your screen
finished; the ticket is not open now
the title of an email, at the top
a polite word at the end of an email
a file that goes with an email
with an answer; the problem is not there now

paras: From Diogo: Hi Linda, I am the IT analyst for ticket 619. Our users can't log in to the VPN, and the connection doesn't work from home. The screenshot of the error is in the attachment. Can you help us, please?
From Linda: Hi Diogo, thank you for your email. Our team is checking the server now. Please update the VPN app and restart the computers. Don't change the port number. I am waiting for your answer.

From Diogo: Hi Linda, good news: the VPN is working now. The users can log in, and they are working from home again. The problem is solved, so you can close the ticket. Thank you for your help. Best regards, Diogo.
reading.source: Alumni by Better -- A1 reading, written for this lesson from the consultation (an email thread with a security vendor; SecureNet is fictional)

A new contract with SecureNet and its price for next year.
A meeting with Linda in the office on Monday.
